brand_identity.name: NEXORA
brand_identity.positioning: Premium Bangladesh-First Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Marketplace & Seller SaaS Ecosystem
brand_identity.core_aesthetic: Fresh, bright, editorial, trustworthy, modern, mobile-first
brand_identity.target_market: Bangladesh urban & national consumers and high-growth digital merchants

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#17211B]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-[#66736B]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous but controlled whitespace, soft rounded cards, crisp 1px borders

grid_modes.marketplace_bento: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6

seller_theme_presets.rule: 90% Nexora platform structural quality, 10% seller brand customization (tone/accent/layout focus)

fashion_editorial.name: Fashion / Editorial
fashion_editorial.vibe: High contrast, tall imagery, minimal borders, runway elegance

cake_bakery_food.name: Cake & Bakery / Warm
cake_bakery_food.vibe: Warm appetizing tones, soft rounded cards, artisanal badge highlights

electronics_technical.name: Electronics / Technical
electronics_technical.vibe: Spec-dense badges, crisp border grids, technical parameters display

beauty_elegant.name: Beauty / Elegant
beauty_elegant.vibe: Soft pastel tones, smooth pill tags, minimalist photography

furniture_home.name: Furniture & Home / Interior
furniture_home.vibe: Room-scale showcase grids, interior tones, texture callouts

grocery_fresh.name: Grocery / Fresh
grocery_fresh.vibe: High density, instant add-to-cart buttons, freshness guarantee badges

jewellery_luxury.name: Jewellery / Luxury Minimal
jewellery_luxury.vibe: Generous framing, subtle amber highlights, detail zoom focus

sports_energetic.name: Sports / Energetic
sports_energetic.vibe: Bold typography, fast add-to-cart, performance parameter tags

books_editorial.name: Books / Editorial Catalog
books_editorial.vibe: Book spine preview ratios, author metadata, summary tabs

interactive_rules.test_id_pattern: kebab-case data-testid on all buttons, links, inputs, cards, menu items, tabs
interactive_rules.hover_states: All buttons must explicit set hover background and hover text color (e.g. hover:bg-[#0D9668] hover:text-white)
interactive_rules.mobile_bottom_nav: Sticky bottom bar on screens < 768px with Home, Categories, Cart (badge), Wishlist, Account

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow light theme specification. Never introduce dark hero cards, black backgrounds, or dark footers.
Use primary emerald (#10B981) for key CTA buttons, price highlights, and positive statuses.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated verification.
Support the 9 seller storefront theme presets on public merchant pages (/shop/[slug]).
Ensure seamless responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
